body: **1. Requesting change: unknown balance is classified as a fundable zero** - Two distinct states land in the unfunded branch and neither means the account has no collateral: an unparseable balance string (NaN, newly caught by `!Number.isFinite`) and absent balance fields (`getTradeableBalance`'s `?? '0'` default). Removing `hasNoAvailableBalance` from `isSubmitDisabled` makes the button live, so a funded trader with a malformed payload gets prompted to deposit collateral they already hold. Suggests a `getTradeableBalanceRaw` sibling accessor plus a `hasKnownBalance` gate.
action: Added `getTradeableBalanceRaw` (no `'0'` fallback) and gated the unfunded branch on `hasKnownBalance`, so absent/unparseable balances fall through to normal trade validation.

body: **2. Requesting change: `trade_submitted_after_deposit` fires without a deposit** - `consumeUnfundedDepositFunnel()` gates only on whether Add funds was clicked in this tab; nothing clears it on abandonment, rejection, or account switch, so an order on a different funded account emits the event for a deposit that never happened. Suggests storing `{ address, confirmedAt }`, setting `confirmedAt` from the deposit-success path, requiring both in `consume`, and clearing on failure.
action: Funnel now stores `{address, confirmedAt}`; confirm runs from the deposit-success path, consume requires a confirmed deposit for the same address, and failure clears it.

body: **3. `deposit_confirmed` double-counts** - The emit sits in a presentation effect whose deps include `entryPoint` and `t`, with no fire-once guard. `clearDepositResult` issues two independent background calls, so `entryPoint` can flip to null while `hasDepositResult` is still true and the effect re-emits. Remounting behind `isUnlocked` also replays it. Suggests the declarative mode of `usePerpsEventTracking` or a `useRef` keyed on the deposit result identity.
action: Added a `useRef` guard keyed on `lastDepositTransactionId` + outcome so the event fires once per deposit; covered by a re-render test.

body: **4. Two derivations of "unfunded" that disagree** - The page owns `hasNoAvailableBalance` (which accounts for `orderMode` and unknown values) but the child re-derives from the raw threshold. A modify-mode trader with all margin committed gets the prominent Add funds button while the page classifies them as funded, so `handleAddFunds` reports `has_perp_balance: true` for a zero-balance account. Pass `hasNoAvailableBalance` down and drop the threshold import.
action: Passed `hasNoAvailableBalance` down as the single source of truth and removed the threshold import from the component; added a modify-mode regression test.

body: **5. Widen-to-`string` on a value derived from an `as const`** - `(buttonLocation: string) =>` throws away the literal union that `PERPS_EVENT_VALUE` already provides, accepting any typo at every call site with no completion. Suggests deriving `PerpsButtonLocation` from the constant.
action: Derived `PerpsButtonLocation` from the `as const`, plus `PerpsDepositClickOutcome` for the new outcome property.

body: **6. New code consuming a `@deprecated` constant** - `BUTTON_LOCATION.TRADING` is marked deprecated in `shared/constants/perps-events.ts:85`. The footer CTA is a new location, so it should get a non-deprecated value alongside `AMOUNT_INPUT` (e.g. `order_form_footer`) or a comment explaining why `trading` is the intended grouping.
action: Added a non-deprecated `ORDER_FORM_FOOTER` location; the deprecated `TRADING` value is no longer referenced by this code.

body: **7. This `else` branch is `trackUnfundedDepositCta` copy-pasted** - Only `has_perp_balance` and the `markUnfundedDepositFunnel()` call differ. Collapse into one helper taking `{ buttonLocation, hasPerpBalance }` that marks the funnel only when unfunded, which also drops `track` and `decodedSymbol` from the callback's dep array.
action: Collapsed both paths into one `trackDepositCta({buttonLocation, isFunded, outcome})` helper; `track` and `decodedSymbol` are gone from the deps.

body: **8. Omitting the property breaks the join** - The funded case spreads in nothing, so no `has_perp_balance` is emitted at all and downstream cannot distinguish a funded user's deposit from a missing property or an older client. The page always sets it; this call site and `perps-deposit-toast.tsx:74` should too.
action: Both call sites now always emit `has_perp_balance` as a boolean.

body: **9. The geo-blocked click is the drop-off you're trying to measure** - In both `handlePrimaryAction` and `handleAddFunds` the `!isEligible` branch returns before any tracking, so a geo-blocked unfunded user's click is invisible in the funnel. Emit the click first, then branch, with the outcome (`geo_block_modal` vs `deposit`) as a property.
action: Both handlers now track before the eligibility branch, with a new `deposit_click_outcome` property; asserted in the geo-block test.

body: **10. Redundant guard** - `onClick={isLoadingAccount ? undefined : onAddFunds}` sits next to `isDisabled={isLoadingAccount}`, which already suppresses the click. Also notes the `ButtonIcon` branch renders even when `onAddFunds` is undefined, unlike the `Button` branch, and that `handleAddFunds`'s `if (isLoadingAccount) return;` is a third copy of the same condition.
action: Dropped the redundant `onClick` guard and kept `isDisabled`; both branches now key off `hasNoAvailableBalance`, with the page-side `isLoadingAccount` return retained as the hydration guard.

body: **11. The comment's rationale doesn't match the value** - `0.01` is not derived from the $10 minimum: 5 USDC also cannot fund a $10 order at 1x and is correctly not unfunded, while 0.5 USDC at 20x clears it. The real rationale is that it rounds to `0.00 USDC` in the displayed balance. Also notes `perpsAddFundsHint` does not name the $10 minimum, so a 2 USDC deposit clears the threshold and then hits Insufficient funds with no explanation.
action: Rewrote the comment to state the display-rounding rationale and pointed at `PERPS_MIN_MARKET_ORDER_USD`; the hint now reads "Add at least $10 to your Perps account to place this order."

body: ### Unfunded CTA shown while balance loads - Medium Severity. `hasNoAvailableBalance` no longer waits for the live account to finish loading and `isSubmitDisabled` dropped the `isLoadingAccount` guard, so a funded wallet looks unfunded until the stream arrives.
action: Already fixed and replied at an earlier commit (002b882c); thread resolved before this run.

body: ### Row CTA ignores account loading - Medium Severity. The available-to-trade row shows the labeled Add funds control while the account stream is still loading, so funded users can briefly see the unfunded row CTA.
action: Already fixed and replied at an earlier commit (948c4315); thread resolved before this run.

body: ### Loading account blocks close and modify - Medium Severity. `isLoadingAccount` now disables submit in every order mode, so a hydrating account stream can block closing or editing a position already on screen.
action: Already fixed and replied at an earlier commit (c82dde9e); thread resolved before this run.
